name: Avocado ice cream
summary: Blended avocado dessert, eaten cold from a cup. In Da Nang it is in the Con Market snack row.
origin: A sweet sold around Da Lat Market, the blended avocado dessert with the market stalls.
howToEat: Eat it standing at the counter while it is still cold.
where: Counters on the Da Lat Market slope, at the night market, and at 76 Nguyễn Văn Trỗi.
In Da Nang, the Con Market snack row on the 12 Jun 2026 page, with bánh tráng cuốn thịt heo, ốc hút, and chè. The page prints 290 Hùng Vương and 06:00–19:00. A Da Nang price is Check on arrival.
priceBand: 20,000–30,000 VND at 76 Nguyễn Văn Trỗi in Da Lat. A Da Nang price is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Avocado ice cream — Da Lat kem bo
seoDescription: Kem bơ, blended avocado, at Da Lat Market and the night stalls. One food-tour note prints 20,000–30,000 VND at 76 Nguyễn Văn Trỗi. Con Market in Da Nang names the cup and prints no price.
